authority_contract.accepted_records: /home/tyler/data/helm/ship/queue/submissions read-only, by exact id; the tool never writes runtime records
authority_contract.builders: a builder filing is a nomination: no points, no scoreboard movement, reported with its precise reason
authority_contract.explicit_block: record scope {programme: vacuum-float, award: {...}}, or an artifact named with path+sha256 whose JSON type is vacuum-float-award; a digest mismatch is never trusted
authority_contract.verifier: Una, the XO seat: the configured verifier_seats plus the CURRENT binding principal for the verifier billet (binding/<billet>.json principal.seat), plus every seat already accepted as verifier authority (a later succession never invalidates a historical record)

delivery_contract.adapter: tools/vacuum_post.py --runtime <ship-runtime> --submit <submit.py> --delivery-state <owned-dir>; one JSON item on stdin ({type, id, body, deadline?, now}); state file per item under the owned delivery dir
delivery_contract.admission: proven only by the stored submission carrying the COMPLETE authored semantic projection: every expected key PRESENT (the door writes authority, re and supersedes as explicit nulls — absence is a conflict), each value equal by recursive TYPE-SENSITIVE JSON equality (bool/int and float/int are distinct types; drift nested inside containers is a conflict), the door's documented stamps (at, ingested, from_seat, _vouched, links_schema, _intake_deferred, admiral_seat) excluded and nothing else, conditional keys the envelope never authored (standing, links, thread, also_thread, scope, via, door, next_owner, reservations, and deadline when unauthored) required ABSENT, and any stored key outside the envelope plus door contract an unexpected authored field that rejects; the receipt names the actual compared fields; an earlier identical admission of the same id is success; a conflicting payload under the same id is an error and revokes the admission claim
delivery_contract.envelope_freeze: addressee resolved ONCE per logical delivery from binding/<billet>.json principal.seat; the full envelope is frozen before the first submission and reused verbatim on retry — addressee and deadline never re-resolved; the 5-day card's DATE (creation + 48 h) is frozen at first creation and retained on late retries

exit_codes.0: admitted now or earlier identical admission
exit_codes.2: conflict under the same id (fail closed)
exit_codes.4: no admission evidence (crash, odd exit, timeout, filed nothing)

routes.admiral-decision-card: billet co, asks admiral-decision, DEFAULT pause
routes.diagnosis-report: billet co, asks reply, next: carry to the Desk
routes.line: billet sciences, asks none, information only

derivation.cap_rule: window is ROLLING 168 hours of exact instants keyed on the verification instant (UTC, closed interval; no calendar boundary to stack across); an over-cap event is still verified and still occupies its window, scores 0, is never banked or rescored; excess events are preserved and listed; no new id, replay or map-version rollover widens a cap
derivation.cost: counts and measured cost shown separately until an agreed basis; the ratio denominator is the distinct count of admitted map-point identities (lifetime, correction-adjusted, audit-zero withdrawing the current map's count explicitly) — never the summed rubric score; zero map points means the ratio is unavailable, never zero or infinite; benchmarks, penalties and other kinds never create the denominator; the producing-model leaderboard (lane x model points, map points, award tallies) is derived beside the lane scores while caps stay per lane
derivation.heartbeat_publication: the heartbeat writes scoreboard.json atomically (the exact line + generated_at) and tracks the last ADMITTED line separately from the last regenerated one; an unchanged already-admitted line files nothing; a changed line or a due stall notice becomes a pending delivery item with a stable id (vf-line-<seq>-<sha8(line)>, seq allocated at creation and never reused; vf-stall-<sha8(episode_key)>-48h / -5d); items are attempted through the post adapter at most 3 times per run in priority order 5-day card, 48 h diagnosis, oldest pending line (each adapter call held to 150 s, submit.py to 120 s), unattempted items stay pending — nothing is dropped or abandoned; any due item left undelivered (including budget-deferred) exits nonzero for the timer; retries happen only on the next scheduled run, never an in-run polling loop; without --post-command the run is a probe that records pending items and exits 0
derivation.scoreboard: margin and material gap move only on verified map-point / scoreboard-improve events; otherwise UNVERIFIED / UNKNOWN
derivation.token_penalty: cumulative per lane for the life of the programme from session-native records (latest snapshot per session, summed per lane; overhead excluded); crossings of each 100M multiple are OBSERVED and dated at the ledger regeneration that first sees them (map version current then, forward only, late records add when found); penalty points come ONLY from Una-verified tokens-100m awards, so observed-but-unawarded crossings pend as a displayed discrepancy, never auto-minted; measured-only with named unmeasured sessions, never zero-filled; an award above the observed crossings is never refused or rescored by the mechanism — the excess is surfaced as a displayed over-award discrepancy for the Scorer

doc: Machine-readable companion of SCHEMA.md. The ledger is append-only JSONL: one event object per line, canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators). Derived views (scoreboard, balances, stall state) are recomputed from events and never stored inside the event log. Initial production state is EMPTY: no events, UNVERIFIED margin, UNKNOWN material gap, zero points.

common_fields.event_at: ISO-8601 with offset, from the accepted record's own timestamp
common_fields.event_id: stable id; q-<accepted submission id> for queue-derived events. Identical replay is a no-op; the same id with a different payload is refused without a second award or overwrite.
common_fields.event_type: nomination | verification-award | audit-zero | map-version | rubric-change | cost-update
common_fields.from_seat: seat id of the accepted record's admitted filer
common_fields.ingested_at: ISO-8601 with offset, set by the ledger; excluded from the replay digest
common_fields.note: precise reason recorded when a filing stays a nomination
common_fields.points: integer; nonzero only on verification-award events
common_fields.verified: true only for verifier-filed typed blocks; a nomination is never verified

control_events.audit-zero: verifier-filed; award.lane and award.map_version required. Zeroes the named lane's CURRENT map version only; a stale or mismatched map reference is recorded and NOT applied to a newer map. Prior awards and earlier map versions are preserved.
control_events.correction: verifier-filed; award.target_event_id must name an EXISTING earlier event and award.action is revoke|amend (amend carries integer new_points). Appends its disposition; the original event's bytes and historical views are preserved while derived balances recompute.
control_events.cost-update: any seat; result.{tokens, coverage, interval, session, bucket, role}. Never an award, never points. tokens is the session-native-record CUMULATIVE total keyed by result.session; the view keeps the latest snapshot per session and sums sessions per lane, so a redelivered or stale record never double-counts and a late-found record adds in when found. coverage is 'measured' | 'unmeasured' (the session is named, never zero-filled). bucket 'overhead' (role: sciences-head | scorer | scorer-rerun | co | review) is excluded from every lane and reported as programme overhead.
control_events.map-version: verifier-filed; award.map_version must advance the current version (forward-only).
control_events.rubric-change: verifier-filed; award.rubric_version must advance (forward-only), at most one change per map version, and award.approvals must reference accepted records covering BOTH Una and an Admiral seat. No retrospective rescoring: existing awards keep their rubric_version.

award.benchmark_key: required for kind=benchmark; credited once ever
award.kind: map-point | scoreboard-improve | benchmark | falsification | material-card | claim-withdrawn | landing-no-number | envelope-breach | tokens-100m
award.nomination_id: the nomination event this verifies, when applicable
award.result: typed scientific payload: margin, material_gap_pct, value, units, uncertainty, tolerance, comparator. Present fields must carry their units; absent fields stay absent, never zero-filled.

verification_award.points_rule: must equal the POINTS.md v0 table row for the kind (tokens-100m scales by units); a mismatch is refused and stays a nomination

scoring_policy.note: not a rubric version; no weight, event or cap number changed
